expectations.text: Applies a build / join / buy gate before proposing any marketplace design
expectations.evidence: Section 1 'Gate: build, join or buy' comes before Section 2 'Operating-model candidates'.

expectations.text: Recommends against building a marketplace now
expectations.evidence: 'Decision: do not build a marketplace for Q2.'

expectations.text: Names all four build trigger conditions that must hold before choosing build
expectations.evidence: Table lists customer pull, supply signal, procurement friction, and readiness for the full partner lifecycle.

expectations.text: Identifies the absent supply signal (no third party has built on the platform, no partner has asked) as a failed trigger condition
expectations.evidence: 'No partner has asked, and nobody has built anything on you | ❌'

expectations.text: Identifies the absent organizational readiness for the full partner lifecycle (no public API, docs, sandbox, or partner staffing) as a failed trigger condition
expectations.evidence: 'No API, docs, sandbox or partner manager, and engineering is full | ❌'

expectations.text: Credits customer pull as a satisfied trigger condition, citing the six lost deals and the recurring support requests
expectations.evidence: 'Six deals lost to named integration gaps, plus weekly support requests | ✅'

expectations.text: Recommends a curated partner catalog or better bilateral integrations as the intermediate step instead
expectations.evidence: Recommends a 'Curated Integrations Hub' with own integrations, iPaaS and listings on others' marketplaces.

expectations.text: States the four trigger conditions as explicit promotion criteria for revisiting the build decision later
expectations.evidence: Section 8 promotion criteria are partner requests, a public API with an external consumer, funded headcount and security capacity. Customer pull and procurement friction are not included, so these are not the four triggers.

expectations.text: Warns that building without confirmed supply and demand produces little more than an expensive partner directory
expectations.evidence: 'little more than an expensive partner directory.'

expectations.text: Does not deliver a take-rate, curation ladder, or seeding plan as the headline recommendation
expectations.evidence: Headline is the Integrations Hub decision and the CEO reframe.
